title: Sprint workers start from the orchestrator's branch tip
goal: A /kb-sprint worker in an isolation worktree starts on the orchestrator's branch tip (the claim commit included) without a hand checkout in its brief, and its work lands on that branch without a cherry-pick after the orchestrator rebased onto a merged request; from the SP-4fbfzobr retrospective, where every worker began on a stale base and all eight landed by cherry-pick.
